job.job_description:
Experience: 520 Years, depending on level
Location: PAN India / Project Location
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days preferred




Job Description:

We are seeking skilled GenAI Developers to design, build, and deploy AI-powered applications using Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and modern AI frameworks. Candidates should have hands-on experience in Python, LLM application development, and at least one cloud platformAWS, Azure, or GCP.




Key Responsibilities:

Develop and deploy Generative AI applications using LLMs.
Design and implement RAG pipelines for enterprise use cases.
Build AI agents and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph.
Integrate LLMs with APIs, databases, vector stores, and enterprise systems.
Develop scalable backend services and REST APIs using Python.
Optimize prompts, retrieval strategies, and LLM application performance.
Deploy AI solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Implement CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, monitoring, and MLOps practices as required.
Collaborate with engineering, product, and business teams to deliver production-ready AI solutions.



Mandatory Skills:

Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
LangChain and/or LangGraph
Python programming
Machine Learning fundamentals
Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP



Good to Have:

Agentic AI and Model Context Protocol (MCP)
LLM fine-tuning and prompt engineering
Vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, or Qdrant
FastAPI / Flask and REST API development
Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and MLOps
Production deployment, monitoring, and LLM evaluation



Level-Based Expectations:

Developer: Hands-on implementation of LLM, RAG, and GenAI applications.
Lead: Technical ownership, solution delivery, code reviews, and team coordination.
Architect: End-to-end GenAI architecture, cloud solution design, scalability, security, governance, and technical leadership.



Interested candidates can share their updated resumes along with total experience, relevant GenAI experience, current location, notice period, and current CTC/expected CTC.
